en.headline: Observatory forecasts cool Saturday morning then cloudier Sunday for Hong Kong
en.dek: Saturday will turn fine and dry after a rather cool morning with urban temperatures of 15 to 22 degrees, while Sunday brings mainly cloudy skies and possible light rain later.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said Saturday would become fine and dry after a rather cool morning under the influence of the northeast monsoon, with urban temperatures ranging from 15 to 22 degrees Celsius and relative humidity between 55 and 80 per cent.

Winds on Saturday are expected to be north to northeast force 4, force 5 at first, and occasionally force 6 on high ground. The Observatory advised that the morning would remain rather cool, with the wind chill effect making conditions feel colder, especially in the New Territories and on higher ground.

On Sunday, the Observatory forecast mainly cloudy skies with bright periods at first and one or two light rain patches later. Temperatures are expected to rise slightly to between 19 and 22 degrees, with east force 5 winds, force 6 offshore and on high ground, and relative humidity of 60 to 85 per cent.

The outlook comes as the Strong Monsoon Signal remains in force for northerly winds. The Observatory has previously noted that an intense northeast monsoon and a cloud band have brought appreciably cooler conditions to the territory this week.

zh.headline: 天文台料周六早上清凉其後轉晴 周日大致多雲有微雨
zh.dek: 周六漸轉天晴乾燥，早上相當清凉，市區氣溫15至22度；周日大致多雲，初時部分時間明朗，稍後有一兩陣微雨。
body: 香港天文台表示，受東北季候風影響，周六會漸轉天晴乾燥，早上相當清凉，市區氣溫介乎15至22度，相對濕度百分之55至80。
周六吹北至東北風4級，初時5級，高地間中6級。天文台指早上仍然相當清凉，風寒效應令體感更冷，新界及高地尤其明顯。
周日大致多雲，初時部分時間天色明朗，稍後有一兩陣微雨，氣溫19至22度，吹東風5級，離岸及高地6級，相對濕度百分之60至85。
強烈季候風信號仍然生效。天文台早前指出，強烈東北季候風及雲雨帶令本周天氣顯著轉凉。
